title: silene nemoralis var. crassicaulis
intro: Silene nemoralis var. crassicaulis, commonly known as Woodland Catchfly or Thick-stemmed Silene, is a variety of the Silene nemoralis plant. This plant is used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Silene nemoralis var. crassicaulis include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be beneficial for conditions such as arthritis and muscle soreness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
